options.plan: B2B Free; upstream workforce entitlement unverified
options.region: No tenant regions selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Entra workforce; new Azure AD connection, v2/oid/single-tenant; separate non-gallery SCIM app; no downstream bridge

conditions: Register a single-tenant Web app in the upstream workforce tenant, configure callback/client credentials and enable the dedicated Microsoft Azure AD connection for the Auth0 application.
Select the Microsoft Identity Platform v2 Identity API; generic OIDC, SAML, workforce-to-External-ID federation and legacy v1 Graph features are different configurations.
The B2B Free offer at https://auth0.com/pricing has one non-Okta Enterprise Connection; both tenant entitlements and limits remain unverified, not a multi-customer or zero-cost guarantee.
Optional Graph profile/group reads and consent do not establish SCIM provisioning or arbitrary custom claims; no runtime application was tested.

evidence.summary: The dedicated Azure AD guide describes registration, connection enablement and single-tenant configuration for provisioning. The selected upstream is Entra workforce, not the Entra External ID candidate.

conditions: Use a new dedicated Azure AD connection with User Object Identifier (oid), Common Endpoint disabled and SCIM externalId mapped from Entra objectId; do not reuse a generic OIDC or legacy pairwise sub mapping.
Set Assignment Required on the OIDC app and assign the same users to a separate non-gallery provisioning app; review its connection-specific bearer token, operation scopes and attribute mappings.
Auth0 Free includes inbound SCIM, but upstream Entra provisioning entitlement and this pair's identity mapping remain unverified; UNKNOWN is not unsupported or inherited from another option.
Entra provisions into Auth0; SaaS permissions, local-session revocation and downstream lifecycle need independent application integration and tests.

evidence.summary: The new-connection SCIM guide requires tenant-specific oid identity correlation and a separate provisioning app. Neither this setup nor upstream commercial access has been verified.

conditions: Enable group provisioning and group operation scopes separately on the provisioning app; OIDC group claims or delegated Graph reads do not establish Group lifecycle synchronization.
Auth0 group names must be unique per connection and members must be users, not nested groups; group-specific entitlement remains unverified.
Organization membership, role assignments, deletion cleanup and SaaS session/access enforcement are separate from inbound group records; no downstream bridge is selected.

evidence.summary: Auth0 describes native Group operations with bounded membership and separate authorization/external-system steps. It does not verify the selected upstream pair's group availability or enforcement.
